Chhattisgarh Minister's WhatsApp Hacked, Fraudulent Payment Requests Made

The WhatsApp account of Chhattisgarh Minister Laxmi Rajwade was hacked. The hacker sent messages from the minister's account requesting money, with one message stating "UPI is blocked, send 32 thousand rupees online." Another message included a UPI QR code and asked for 52 thousand rupees. The minister later clarified the situation, warning the public to be cautious of fake messages demanding money.
